Question 10
?

Consider the arc of the curve x=y2−2y that lies in the second quadrant between its y-intercepts. What integral gives the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
 2π∫02y4y2−8y+5dy
b
 2π∫01(y2−2y)4y2−8y+5dy
c
 2π∫02y4y2+5dy
d
 2π∫02(y2−2y)4y2+5dy
e
 2π∫01y4y2−8y+1dy
Submit
